model: v5 hierarchical STAGED (stage1 idle/walk/transient -> stage2 sit_down/stand_up/lie_down/fall/noise), built on top of the 2026-08-02 LiveEventDetector merge-gap fix -- see STATE.md
trained_on: data/processed/g3_features_v5_with_noise.parquet (v3's 3487 windows + 33 new 'noise' windows from 2026-08-02_clean_scripted_session, extracted with the FIXED streaming detector, not the fragmenting one v4 used)
fall_threshold_calibration: NOT YET RECALIBRATED -- must re-sweep against the 5-class stage2 softmax (noise now competes for probability mass) before deployment. See STATE.md.
requires: inference/realtime_classifier.py's LiveEventDetector merge-gap fix (2026-08-02) -- this model's event boundaries assume merged events, same as v3 always did. Do NOT pair with a pre-fix LiveEventDetector.
known_limitation: noise class trained on 33 examples from a SINGLE session -- no leave-one-session-out validation possible for this class yet. Also unvalidated: full LOSO retrain-per-fold using the fixed segmentation (current validation is in-sample replay scoring against curated sessions, not held-out). Both should happen before treating this as production-hardened.
calibration_note: This threshold governs ONLY the binary fall-vs-not-fall decision, calibrated separately from stage1/stage2's own argmax outputs (which remain uncalibrated -- used as-is for idle/walk/sit_down/stand_up/lie_down/noise predictions).
